units.title: Data Governance and Knowledge Graph Construction
gaps: No unified DataGovernanceEngine/policy registry -- governance fragmented across 4 domain engines
KnowledgeGraphEngine graph is a ~35-node in-memory seed (seedGraph :124-255), not the automated all-sources builder; system-viz graph not bridged to graph_query
No prism_memory/prism_context route for graph actions verified
Physics/rules version audit is git-only, no queryable surface
units.nextAction: Bridge the two existing graph substrates (system-viz sidecars -> KnowledgeGraphEngine ingest or prism_context read action) and ship a thin DataGovernancePolicy registry federating MemoryGovernance/WEDMGovernanceStore/DocumentControl/WetRunRetention; no new graph builder.

units.title: Exception Pattern Learning and Automated Rule Generation
gaps: analyzeException uses canned per-type templates (:97-133) -- no real cross-event pattern mining/clustering
In-memory only (ring buffer :59); export()/import() persistence surface unwired
Generated tribal tips never persisted into the tribal-knowledge store
No exception->rule pipeline (TurningRulesGenerator is lathe-only, catalog-driven)
No validation on real JM Die exceptions -- all tests synthetic
units.nextAction: Extend, do not rebuild: wire export/import persistence + dispatcher actions, close the tribal-tip loop into the real store, mine actual JM Die exceptions (scrap/NCR/regressions) into the engine, add frequency/cluster analysis over the persisted corpus, and gate any learning claim on measured before/after metrics.

units.title: Long-Term Data Retention and Digital Thread Completeness
gaps: Retention siloed per domain (wet-run/docs/memories/ledgers) -- no cross-system policy layer over all PRISM state
DigitalThreadEngine.trace is pure-input; no walker constructs threads from real JM Die artifacts, so 100%-coverage audit and real-data validation criteria unmet
No archive-to-cold-storage strategy, only purge scheduling
units.nextAction: Build the connector, not engines: a DigitalThreadWalker that enumerates real JM Die part artifacts into DigitalThreadInput for the existing trace(), reporting honest per-part coverage for >=3 parts, plus a RetentionPolicyRegistry federating the four existing retention surfaces behind one prism_memory-wired query action importing WetRunRetentionPolicyEngine regime windows.

units.title: Forward Compatibility and Version Control of Physics/Rules/Souls
gaps: Forward-compat is warn-and-continue (stateMigrations.ts:45), no active checker validating N+1 consumers before a bump
stateMigrations registry covers only 5 state files; MigrationEngine generic/in-memory and disconnected from real files
No semantic-version/change-impact surface for physics constants (git-only)
No rule-change replay/validation harness found in searched scope
units.nextAction: Unify the two existing halves: bind devDispatcher-wired MigrationEngine to the real stateMigrations registry, enumerate then expand LATEST_VERSION coverage across all schemaVersioned data/state files, and add a prism_dev forward_compat_check action (migration-path check + live round-trip + constants.ts consumer blast-radius report), validated against the G170/G168 dialect regression as the reference case.
